CustomMetadata.label: No sensitive fields in agent scope

values.value: Remove sensitive fields from the agent's scope. If the use case really needs one, mask it before it reaches the model (for example with Einstein Trust Layer data masking), hide it with field-level security where you can, and record the decision in the DPIA.
No grounding field is classified as sensitive or looks like special-category data.

Checks whether any of the agent's grounding fields is classified as Confidential, Restricted or Mission Critical, or looks like special-category data (health, religion, ethnicity, vulnerability, minors) by its name or label.
GDPR Article 9 - Special categories of personal data|https://gdpr-info.eu/art-9-gdpr/
